_about: The formats this stream may write in, as data: scripts/plan_queries.py draws one per draft (with a logic) by weight over how each did before, inside the 60/25/15 budget of proven, variation and experiment, and writes the seed and the draw on the note; the theme-writer follows the drawn format's `structure`. Read through scripts/memory.py (load_formats). A person edits this file; a stream without it writes theme posts only. `channels` are the channels a format fits (blog, linkedin, x). `weight` is how often to try it before any result exists (1 when left out). `needs_evidence: true` keeps a format off a theme whose licence is `held`: it cannot be written without a row at grade evidenced. `skill` names a plugin skill the writer uses for the format's own craft, where there is one.

theme-post.name: Theme post with teasers
theme-post.when: a content-shaped finding with a fact to anchor on, or a theme's introduction
structure: hook
the change or the deadlock
the structural reading
the standing point: the theme's differentiator
the honest limit, in the post's own words
theme-post.length: 350 to 700 words; a LinkedIn teaser of 60 to 120 words and an X teaser, each re-cut

x-thread.name: X thread
x-thread.when: an argument with four to seven steps that each stand as one post
structure: the hook post, which stands alone
one step of the argument per post
the turn: what the reader did not expect
the standing point
the honest limit and the link

short-take.name: Short take
short-take.when: one observation that needs no article behind it
structure: the observation, in one or two sentences
why it is not the obvious reading
the honest limit where it claims anything
short-take.length: under 80 words on LinkedIn, one post on X

quote-commentary.name: Quote commentary
quote-commentary.when: someone else's public post, by an author we may name, says something our argument turns
structure: what they said, quoted or linked, never paraphrased into something else
the one thing we add
where we differ or what follows

question.name: Question
question.when: the honest position is that the question is open, and the audience holds part of the answer
structure: the question, as the hook
why it is open: the two readings
what would settle it

data-note.name: Data note
data-note.when: one figure from a primary source changes how a theme reads
structure: the figure, with its source and date
what it measures and what it does not
the reading
the honest limit

motion-card.name: Motion card
motion-card.when: a gated post has two or three lines that carry the argument on their own
structure: lines lifted word for word from the post
the theme hashtag
the link
motion-card.length: a card of 3 to 5 lines; the post it comes from is its text

case-story.name: Case story
case-story.when: something of ours is evidenced: shown, signed or published by the party it concerns
structure: the situation, before
what was done, with its evidence
what changed, in the evidence's own terms
what it does not show
